violated_contract: A live STT leg that has accepted speech but has not emitted text must not hold the user through repeated empty decodes without a bounded switch to a replacement provider.
canonical_prevention: Bound the first-text wait from first VAD speech and the consecutive speech-containing empty POST count. Fail the leg through the existing capture-positioned replay path, exclude the failed provider for the session, and test both triggers, disarming after text, and replay without duplicate emission.
